description: Generate a random raw key (data encryption key) wrapped by the specified master key. Used for envelope encryption. Only AES256 or RSA2048 key types supported.

context.description: Base64-encoded context for convergent encryption (max 50 bytes)

keyTag.description: Key tag - unique identifier derived from key name

requestPlainKey.description: Whether to return the plaintext key (default: false)

name: ncloud_kms_create_custom_key
